source_evidence: Day330~21:03 exact player 'Well they are claiming something very different from you. Just want to make sure things are right. Can you tell me more about the situation?' V addresses leader from established camp without additional approach, threat or movement. Leader elaborates false justification that captives were caught leaving employer's property and his party are hired men, not town Watch; deliberately declines specific employer or verification. Woman says 'We live on a farm north of here! They came after sunset and dragged us out of our house. Ask them where this silver is!' This is her firsthand statement, consistent with already fixed private truth of ransom abduction; no farm location beyond north, no verified relationship, no actual silver stolen or recovered and no confirmation of legal authority. Guard tightens grip on woman's arm, orders silence, no quantified injury, attack or resource spend. Leader says private business, no quarrel, wants to end conversation and proceed with captives. Cirren observes contradictory stories and lack of named lawful authority; does not magically know truth or redo earlier failed Insight. Fenar remains poised, no initiative or attack. Mara near coach. V chooses how to respond before escort resumes; group still halted on road around80ft away, no auto-movement for V or expenditure. No new rolls because NPCs voluntarily give these claims and observable actions, no contested persuasion result or truth confirmation.
